name: Edendale
subtitle: Private movie & show library
promotionalText: Play the movies and shows you own on the big screen: a private, ad-free library with rich TMDB details, Continue Watching, and a Watchlist.
description:
Edendale is a free, open-source video player and personal watch tracker for Apple TV. It plays the movies and shows you already own on the big screen: no account, no ads, no analytics.

MADE FOR THE LIVING ROOM
- A focus-driven interface designed for the Siri Remote.
- Big, cinematic artwork for your movies, shows, seasons, and episodes.
- Fast search across your library and the people in it.

PLAY WHAT YOU OWN
- Play from your own network shares (SMB) or device-local files.
- Comfortable on-screen controls with a full timeline, chapters, playlists, and audio and subtitle track selection.
- Load online subtitles on demand, or use the tracks inside your files.

A LIBRARY WITH REAL DETAIL
- Filenames are classified locally, then optionally enriched with metadata from TMDB.
- Browse cast, crew, seasons, episodes, and release dates in a layout built for TV.

TRACK AND CONTINUE
- Continue Watching remembers your place on every title.
- Keep a Watchlist of what to watch next, and rate what you have seen.
- A Young Audience filter keeps the living room age-appropriate.

PRIVATE BY DESIGN
- No Edendale account and no analytics. Your library and watch history stay with you and the services you choose to connect.

Edendale uses the TMDB API but is not endorsed or certified by TMDB.
whatsNew:
Welcome to Edendale: a free, open-source video player and personal watch tracker.

- Play the movies and shows you already own from your own network shares and device-local files.

Thank you for trying Edendale.
